G'oya

Ikki bosqich. Avval har bir mijozning jami xaridini topib, unga segment beramiz. Keyin segmentlar bo'yicha yana guruhlab, mijozlarni sanaymiz. Ikkinchi GROUP BY birinchisining natijasi ustida ishlaydi, shuning uchun birinchi bosqich FROM ichiga hosila jadval bo'lib kiradi.

Yechim

SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  SELECT c.id,
         CASE
           WHEN SUM(o.amount) >= 500000 THEN 'katta'
           WHEN SUM(o.amount) >= 100000 THEN 'orta'
           ELSE 'kichik'
         END AS segment
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id
) t
GROUP BY segment

LEFT JOIN buyurtmasiz mijozlarni ham saqlab qoladi. Ularning SUM i NULL, NULL >= 500000 esa rost ham, yolg'on ham emas, shuning uchun ikkala WHEN o'tkazib yuboriladi va mijoz ELSE ga, ya'ni 'kichik' ga tushadi. COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) yozsangiz ham xato emas, lekin bu yerda natijani o'zgartirmaydi. CASE birinchi rost shartda to'xtaydi, shuning uchun ikkinchi WHEN da "500 000 dan kam" ni qayta yozish shart emas.

Namunada Aziz 550 000 bilan 'katta', Dilnoza va Malika 'orta', Jasur (70 000) va buyurtmasiz Nodir 'kichik'.

Tuzoqlar

Oddiy JOIN Nodirni yo'qotadi: buyurtmasi yo'q mijoz ulanmaydi va 'kichik' segmentda 2 emas, 1 chiqadi.

Noto'g'riSELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  SELECT c.id,
         CASE
           WHEN SUM(o.amount) >= 500000 THEN 'katta'
           WHEN SUM(o.amount) >= 100000 THEN 'orta'
           ELSE 'kichik'
         END AS segment
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id
) t
GROUP BY segment

"500 000 va undan ko'p" degani >=. > bilan aynan 500 000 lik mijoz 'orta' ga tushib qoladi.

Buyurtmalarni segmentlash ham xato. Azizning 300 000 va 250 000 lik buyurtmalari alohida olinsa ikkalasi 'orta', birgalikda esa u 'katta' mijoz. Segment mijozga beriladi, shuning uchun avval yig'indi.
